feature_name: Add @types/pg as runtime dependency for adapter-pg
description: Move the @types/pg package from devDependencies to dependencies in the PostgreSQL adapter's package.json to ensure TypeScript types are automatically available to consumers. This will resolve type resolution issues that occur when users install adapter-pg without manually installing the pg type definitions.
functional_requirements: Update adapter-pg's package.json to include @types/pg in dependencies section
Remove @types/pg from devDependencies section in package.json
Update package lock file to reflect the dependency change
Ensure no runtime behavior changes occur - this is purely a TypeScript type resolution improvement
